linea_en: Systematic review with 14 studies. Samples and participant descriptions are heterogeneous; it does not allow one AAC system to be chosen for everyone.

heading: Augmentative and alternative communication interventions with speech-generating devices for autistic preschoolers: a systematic review
titleEs: Augmentative and alternative communication interventions with speech-generating devices for autistic preschoolers: a systematic review
text: El estudio encuentra efectos moderados/fuertes en parte de los estudios y revisa validez ecológica/social.
notProven: Menos de la mitad cumplió validez ecológica completa y solo 7 evaluaron validez social.
linea: Revisión sistemática con 20 estudios (1998-2023). Menos de la mitad cumplió validez ecológica completa y solo 7 evaluaron validez social.
heading_en: Speech-generating AAC interventions for autistic preschoolers
text_en: The study finds moderate/strong effects in some studies and reviews ecological/social validity.
notProven_en: Less than half met full ecological validity and only 7 assessed social validity.
linea_en: Systematic review with 20 studies (1998-2023). Less than half met full ecological validity and only 7 assessed social validity.

heading: A systematic review of interventions for echolalia in autistic children
titleEs: A systematic review of interventions for echolalia in autistic children
text: La mayoría de intervenciones intentaba reducir ecolalia, pero la calidad global fue muy baja y se ignoró con frecuencia su función comunicativa.
notProven: No justifica una recomendación clínica general de 'eliminar' ecolalia.
linea: Revisión sistemática con 15 estudios. No justifica una recomendación clínica general de 'eliminar' ecolalia.
heading_en: Interventions for echolalia in autistic children
text_en: Most interventions attempted to reduce echolalia, but overall quality was very low and its communicative function was often ignored.
notProven_en: It does not justify a general clinical recommendation to 'eliminate' echolalia.
linea_en: Systematic review with 15 studies. It does not justify a general clinical recommendation to 'eliminate' echolalia.

heading: Intervention techniques targeting echolalia in autistic people: a scoping review
titleEs: Intervention techniques targeting echolalia in autistic people: a scoping review
text: El estudio confirma que gran parte de la literatura se centra en reducción y pocas investigaciones miden comunicación funcional.
notProven: Mapear estudios no equivale a demostrar eficacia; refuerza la cautela ante objetivos puramente reductores.
linea: Scoping review con 74 artículos. Mapear estudios no equivale a demostrar eficacia; refuerza la cautela ante objetivos puramente reductores.
heading_en: Intervention techniques targeting echolalia in autistic people
text_en: The study confirms that much of the literature focuses on reduction and that few studies measure functional communication.
notProven_en: Mapping studies is not the same as demonstrating effectiveness; it reinforces caution about purely reduction-oriented goals.
linea_en: Systematic review with 74 articles. Mapping studies is not the same as demonstrating effectiveness; it reinforces caution about purely reduction-oriented goals.

heading: Auditory Processing Disorder in Childhood: A Critical Review
titleEs: Auditory Processing Disorder in Childhood: A Critical Review
text: El estudio subraya solapamientos con TDL, dislexia, TDAH y autismo y cuestiona la validez de algunas herramientas diagnósticas en desarrollo.

heading_en: Auditory processing disorder in childhood
text_en: The study emphasises overlaps with DLD, dyslexia, ADHD and autism and questions the validity of some diagnostic tools in development.

linea_en: Cross-sectional study with Diagnostic and developmental literature. APD should not be used as an automatic explanation for any difficulty listening in noise.

heading: Misophonia: a systematic review of current and future trends in this emerging clinical field
titleEs: Misophonia: a systematic review of current and future trends in this emerging clinical field
text: El estudio describe un campo emergente con gran variación de definiciones y herramientas.

linea: Revisión sistemática. No valida un diagnóstico universal ni permite equiparar misofonía con hiperacusia o APD.

text_en: The study describes an emerging field with wide variation in definitions and tools.
